zh: 需要 ARK-01 到现场：{name}（装配头）
{girl}：那间塌掉的棚屋，我们先把它清出来好不好？
en: {girl}: That collapsed shed... can we clear it out first?

zh: {girl}：储罐旁边冒出了一点绿色……我们别动那边，好吗？
en: {girl}: Something green is growing by the tank... can we leave that spot alone?

zh: {girl}：断墙后面会有什么呀？我想把它清掉看看！
en: {girl}: What's behind that broken wall? I want to clear it and see!

zh: {girl}：我想先把发电设备修好，这样别的才能用电。
en: {girl}: I want to fix the generator first, so everything else gets power.

zh: {girl}：工业区那间厂房，清出来能用好多材料！
en: {girl}: If we clear that factory, we'll get loads of materials!

zh: 现在不行，因为材料要留着
en: Not now, we need the materials

zh: {girl}：等等！那边有植物，拆的时候会伤到它们……真的要拆吗？（再点一次确认）
en: {girl}: Wait! There are plants there... they'll get hurt. Do you really want to clear it? (Click again to confirm)
{girl}: Hmm... I don't really want to build here.
{girl} found a clue on her own: {name}

zh: {girl}自己处理了一件意外，没来找你。
en: {girl} handled an accident herself and didn't come to you.
{girl}: This is the {name}! I've never been here before.
{girl}: One of the machines just stopped! What do we do?

zh: {girl}：那边看起来好危险，可是我好想过去看看……
en: {girl}: It looks dangerous over there, but I really want to go see...
